items.t: "Sardis East Vedder" is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack; the City publishes no boundary for it.

Plan frame: Sardis as a whole sits inside the Schedule B5 Sardis Neighbourhood Plan area of the 2050 OCP (Bylaw 2025, No. 5500), with Schedule B6 South Vedder to the south; the Agricultural Plan is Schedule B1 of the same bylaw, and Schedule D is the Development Permit Areas schedule.

Where the condo stock concentrates: one short Stevenson Road cluster in the Sardis Park area — three apartment buildings within a few doors of each other at 45753, 45761 and 45769 Stevenson Road. The rest of the guide page's feed (1-12 / 32 at reading) was detached-led Sardis Park / Stevenson Road product.
Landmarks the page headlines: Sardis Park (6898 School Lane, per the page); the Sardis Sports Complex (5725 Tyson Road) and Sardis Library (5819 Tyson Road) sit in Sardis South.

Also Ministry-confirmed on this side but not named on the guide page: Vedder Elementary, 45850 Promontory Rd; Promontory Heights Community Elementary, 46200 Stoneview Dr; GW Graham Secondary, 45955 Thomas Rd. SD33 catchments are address-based and no locator run for a Sardis East Vedder address is on record, so catchment schools for any specific address are UNVERIFIED.
Health care: Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Road, is a Fraser Health community hospital.

Board geography: Chilliwack is a Chilliwack and District Real Estate Board (CADREB) market, not a Fraser Valley or Greater Vancouver board market, and CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only, with no sub-area tables.

Guide feed (snapshot only, re-read in the batch-18 triple-check, Nov 1, 2026): the feed is headed "Sardis East Vedder Homes for Sale | Chilliwack BC" and counted 1-12 / 32 — the first-page cards read are detached-led Sardis Park / Stevenson Road product, with a 45+ gated manufactured-home unit (Country Park Village per listing text) among them. blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Sardis East Vedder Guide

items.t: OCP — City of Chilliwack Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 ("Chilliwack 2050"): Sardis is Schedule B5; the other Schedule B plans are B1 Agricultural Area, B2 Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island, B3 Downtown (Downtown Neighbourhood Plan, with D-6 among the permit areas), B4 Eastern Hillsides, B6 South Vedder and B7 Yarrow; Schedule C is the Mountain View Heritage Conservation Area and Schedule D is the Development Permit Areas schedule (D-1 through D-10, including D-2 Hillside Environment and D-5 Hillside Development).
: A specific parcel's zone is a per-parcel City check: UNVERIFIED here for any parcel.
SSMUH — Bylaw 5395 (adopted Jun 18, 2024), amending Zoning Bylaw 5000: allows 3 to 4 dwelling units on parcels within the urban growth boundary zoned for single-detached and duplex housing.

Suites and accessory units — Bylaw 5000: a secondary suite is capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the habitable floor space of the building (s.2); only 1 accessory dwelling unit may be located on a lot (secondary suite, coach house or garden suite; garden suites capped at 100 m², s.4.06(1)); ADU parking 1 space for a 1-bedroom ADU or any secondary suite, 2 spaces for a 2-or-more-bedroom coach or garden suite (s.5.04); a suite must be built with a building permit, meet the BC Building and Fire Code and current flood protection requirements, and new secondary suites are not permitted below the flood construction level. Do not price a lot as if it can carry a suite plus a coach house.

Subdivision and servicing — Approving Officer / Preliminary Layout Approval process (City Subdivision Application Guide): a Chilliwack subdivision proceeds by application to the City's Approving Officer, with Preliminary Layout Approval setting the conditions (servicing, works and dedications) before final approval and registration. On hillside ground, price the permit layer, not just the plan: confirm the parcel's D-2 / D-5 permit areas and required reports with the City before pricing a build or a subdivision.

Property taxes — City of Chilliwack: notices mailed annually at the end of May, taxes due the first working day after July 1, a 5% late payment penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026, and an additional 5% penalty to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.
Pad tenure (where met — Country Park Village): a manufactured home on a rented pad is NOT lot stock and NOT land ownership. The park's own lease/tenancy documents govern.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sardis East Vedder Guide

items.t: Knight Road is filed on both sides of the Vedder Road divider (Nov 1, 2026). Board data labels Country Park Village (45918 Knight Road) "Sardis East Vedder," while Knight Lodge and Cotton Ridge (45660 / 45645 Knight Road) are labelled "Sardis West Vedder" — the same street on both sides of the divider in board data. A buyer who filters by sub-area label alone will misfile Knight Road product; the address, not the label, governs.

The Sardis Sports Complex and Sardis Library are not on this side. The guide page places the Sardis Sports Complex (5725 Tyson Road) and Sardis Library (5819 Tyson Road) in the Sardis South area — Sardis Park (6898 School Lane, per the page) is this ground's landmark, not the Tyson Road pair.

The hillside permit layer is two separate areas, not one. The City's Schedule D separates D-2 Hillside Environment from D-5 Hillside Development as distinct permit areas — on Promontory-side ground, which areas apply to a parcel and what reports they require is a per-parcel City check, UNVERIFIED here.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Sardis East Vedder?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Sardis East Vedder?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Sardis East Vedder?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Sardis East Vedder?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How many apartment-condo buildings are there in Sardis East Vedder?
faq.a: Everything else in the guide feed is detached-led.

faq.q: Is there a median price for Sardis East Vedder condos?
faq.a: No. Chilliwack is not covered by SnapStats and CADREB publishes no sub-area statistics — no median, sales ratio or inventory figure for this sub-area exists in the sources used, and none is stated here. Price from the property's own CADREB comparables.

faq.q: Are Park Ridge, Park Place 1 and the 45753 building the same complex?
faq.a: No — three separate addresses (45753, 45761, 45769 Stevenson Road) with three separate build years (2008, 2016, 2005) in the listing records. The 45753 building's name is UNCONFIRMED; do not let a search blur the three into one strata.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Stevenson Road condo long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, and the City licenses short-term rental operations under Bylaw No. 5141.

faq.q: Is Country Park Village a condo community?
faq.a: No. It is a gated 45+ manufactured-home community at 45918 Knight Road on First Nations lease land — you buy the manufactured home, not a strata lot, and there is no Form B. It appears in this area's listing feed, which is why it is flagged here.

faq.q: Are Park Ridge, Park Place 1 and the 45753 building the same complex?
faq.a: No — three separate addresses (45753, 45761, 45769 Stevenson Road) with three build years (2008, 2016, 2005).

faq.q: Can I rent out a Stevenson Road condo long-term?
faq.a: Yes — rental-restriction bylaws are unenforceable since Nov 24, 2022.

faq.q: Which plan governs — the page says Schedule D / Bylaw 5024?
faq.a: The page is stale. Sardis is Schedule B5 of OCP Bylaw 2025, No. 5500; Schedule D is Development Permit Areas.
